content.text:
Based on the context research, I have found the answer. The configuration parameter name that controls the number of threads used for the assignment computation offload is `group.coordinator.background.threads`.

This was initially proposed as `group.coordinator.executor.threads` but was renamed to `group.coordinator.background.threads`. The rename was announced on 2026-03-01 by Sean Quah and PR #21555 implementing this configuration was merged on 2026-03-03, well before the snapshot date of 2026-03-31.
